sourcePolicy.reference: v9 core sit/walk color, texture, outline, fur density, and proportions

attention.intent: Puppy asks the user for attention after being ignored or clicked.

rest.intent: Puppy winds down, sleeps, and can be woken by clicking.

curious.intent: Puppy notices small environmental changes and investigates.

food.intent: Puppy finds or reacts to tiny food-like cues.

turn.intent: Puppy checks behind itself without impossible head twists.

sit.intent: Quiet waiting and listening beats between larger actions.

mood.intent: Short emotional reactions for clicks, wakeups, and transitions.

roam.intent: Tiny patrol beats. Step-left and step-right may move in proof, patrol-sniff stays in place.
